Dualite Claims — ECHS & RGHS claims, checked, sealed and filed

Dualite reads every scanned claim file, checks it against 50+ case rules, applies your seal and signature, and prepares it on the ECHS or RGHS portal, in seconds rather than hours. Your team approves before anything is final.

Dualite reconciles every claim across three sources: its status and approved amount on the scheme portal, the bill in your hospital management system, and the credits in your bank account, matched by UTR. Your dashboard shows which claims are paid in full, short-paid or approved but not yet credited.
ECHS and RGHS, for both OPD and IPD claims. Each scheme’s own rules decide the page order, which pages get a seal and signature, and what the portal needs.
Each step, each change and each stamp is logged with a time, on every file.

Every bill, report and prescription is collated into one indexed, portal-ready PDF. It is then checked line by line against 50+ case rules, so missed charges and mismatches are caught before they cost you revenue.
